hero.title: Resource Management
hero.lead: INPUT SOFT Resource Management Software Suite plans, rosters, and controls all your resources in real time, from staff and GSE to fixed resources. Every turnaround is fully covered, even when the schedule changes.

image.alt: Real-time planning: live staff timeline with flights and tasks, delayed flights, and the Insights panel showing staff shortages by day and hour

items.title: Resource planning
items.text: Automated planning of staff, equipment, and GSE based on requirements and flight schedules.

items.title: Staff rostering
items.text: Intelligent shift rostering that stays compliant, adjusts for absences or changes, and reduces manual effort.

items.title: Real-time planning
items.text: Dynamic task updates, reassignments, and mobile notifications for responsive daily execution.

checklist.text: Automatically allocate human, technical (GSE) and airport resources, such as check-in desks, parking stands and baggage belts.
Our algorithms calculate the optimal number of shifts and staff, ensuring the right personnel are in place at the right time.
Assign tasks based on flight schedules, available resources and staff qualifications to ensure seamless operations.
Schedule GSE and eGSE usage and charging based on workload and shift requirements for efficient resource management.

image.alt: Resource planning: shift plan with staff, shifts, qualifications and tasks on a timeline, with the workload curve and planning totals

checklist.text: Automatically generate staff rosters based on flight schedules and shift requirements.
Create work schedules, tasks and ready-to-go rosters with a single click.
Customize parameters for various “what-if” scenarios, enabling quick adjustments to evolving needs — with vacations, sick leave and personal requests taken into account.
Download reports or send roster schedules directly to employees via the INPUT SOFT app or WhatsApp.

image.alt: Staff roster with employees, contracts, daily shifts, leave and total hours

checklist.text: Integration with existing databases (AODB, AOCC, etc.) or a direct connection to the satellite ADS-B data feed for real-time updates.
Receive immediate notifications on schedule changes, ensuring seamless operations.
Automatically reassign tasks in case of delays and notify employees via the app or WhatsApp for fast communication.
Save valuable time through real-time adjustments, improving operational efficiency and overall performance.

image.alt: Real-time planning: live staff timeline with flight details, delayed flights and the task change log

rows.title: Gain total visibility over your operations

checklist.text: Visual dashboards turn your daily operational data into clear statistics, so you can track performance trends and evaluate execution quality across all flights.
Monitor key performance indicators like turnaround times, delay codes, and service metrics on fully customizable dashboards.
Easily sync your recorded data and performance history with external BI systems like Power BI for advanced reporting.

image.alt: Reports dashboard with flights, FTE, worked and paid hours, and charts by day and aircraft type

rows.title: Keep your team connected in real time

checklist.text: View daily or monthly shifts and tasks in a clear, mobile-friendly format on iOS and Android.
Get push notifications for task changes, flight delays, or reassignments as they happen.
Accept or decline updates with comments, syncing your response instantly with the platform.
